research_topic: Exact identity and public YouTube inventory for Camilla Stephenson

confirmed_observations.claim: Exact-name web searches for 'Camilla Stephenson' combined with YouTube, XRP and channel terms did not return a verified XRP-focused YouTube channel or upload catalogue for that exact identity.
confirmed_observations.limitation: Search-engine absence is not proof that no such channel exists.

confirmed_observations.claim: A public LinkedIn profile for Camilla Stephenson identifies a Melbourne-based marketing/PR professional associated with Sheet Society. Public posts describe brand/social work. No XRP or crypto YouTube connection was found in the retrieved evidence.

A public film-industry mentor page identifies a Camilla Stephenson working in location management. Pathé's La Dame de Fer production page also credits a Camilla Stephenson in the production/locations section. No relationship to the XRP YouTube candidate was established.

A New Zealand OIA response lists 'Camilla (Millie) Stephenson' in the UK market as a content creator under the name/handle 'Wholesome Mils'. The document does not connect this person to XRP, the candidate Kamilah Stevenson channel, or the requested YouTube inventory.

The previously catalogued XRP-focused candidate channel is titled 'Kamilah Stevenson' and uses @drkamilahstevenson, candidate channel ID UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA. YouTube's accessible channel page labels it Kamilah Stevenson, not Camilla Stephenson. Some third-party transcript snippets reportedly render the spoken name as 'Camila Stevenson', but that is not sufficient identity evidence.

candidate_video_scope.note: The eight previously catalogued XRP-related video URLs belong only to the unverified Kamilah/Camila Stevenson candidate set. They must not be described as videos posted by Camilla Stephenson until a direct self-identification or cross-linked official account establishes the match.

identity_hypotheses.statement: The requested Camilla Stephenson is the Kamilah/Camila Stevenson XRP video creator.
identity_hypotheses.support: Similar spoken first-name rendering and XRP-related candidate videos.
identity_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Channel title and handle identify Kamilah, not Camilla; no verified official cross-link to an exact-name Camilla profile.

identity_hypotheses.statement: The requested person is another exact-name Camilla Stephenson, such as a professional or content creator appearing in public records.
identity_hypotheses.support: Multiple distinct exact-name public profiles exist.
identity_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: No retrieved exact-name profile was connected to the XRP video catalogue.

next_actions: Do not merge the Camilla, Camila and Kamilah identities.
Search for a direct self-identification on a verified YouTube channel or an official social account that links to the XRP videos.
Once a channel ID is verified, enumerate its uploads playlist and preserve video ID, title, publication timestamp, visibility, duration and source URL.
Do not claim the eight candidate videos are authored by Camilla Stephenson; retain them as an unattributed candidate set.
Keep the identity and inventory status unresolved rather than inventing a match.
